## What it is

An editable, named-component reconstruction of the Neewer GM-MP2 140 mm macro focusing rail. The default pose follows the product photograph: both support feet are deployed and the rotating top Arca assembly is turned one 90-degree detent transverse to the rail. Use the `reference_pose` variant for comparison against the supplied scan.

The manufacturer specifies 140 mm carriage travel, four 90-degree rotation locks, two retractable support feet, double Arca quick release, 1/4-inch and 3/8-inch mounting points, 512 g mass, and 2.5 kg payload. Source: https://neewer.com/products/neewer-gm-mp2-140mm-macro-focusing-rail-slider-with-360-rotation-66606520

## Design notes

- The frame, end blocks, rods, lead screw, focus knob, carriage, rotary base, Arca clamp, plate, clamp knob, and both feet remain separately selectable components.
- `references/neewer-outer-focus-sleeve.step` is preserved as exact B-rep geometry and placed on the scan-derived large-knob axis. Its outer cylinder is 22 mm diameter and 5 mm wide; its eightfold opening is the authoritative tight-fit interface.
- Fitting that opening to the scan gave 0.097 mm median radial clearance (about 0.19 mm diametral) and 0.093 mm RMS residual. Tiny negative patches remain, so these scan-derived fit values stay provisional.
- Scan-derived values in `measurements.toml` remain provisional. The CAD uses analytic primitives and intentionally omits triangle noise, branding, scale markings, rubber texture, fastener threads, and cosmetic knurling.
- The supplied scan captures folded feet and a sideways Arca detent. Those are pose differences, not reconstruction errors; the `reference_pose` variant separates them from the default product-photo pose.
- The stored `.ply.gz` is a deterministic geometry-only binary PLY conversion of the supplied `neewer-macro-slide-GM-MP2.stl`. It preserves all 126,072 vertices, 252,204 faces, bounds, and area from the repaired watertight STL; the source STL SHA-256 is `1d134187bd303830bd58c082fa5f4268afb295ea5a70fbf575cf312dcc17f5c7`.
- A 3,000-sample bidirectional comparison of `reference_pose` at the declared 0.75 mm tolerance estimated 42.1% CAD-to-reference coverage with 7.22 mm p95, and 54.0% reference-to-CAD coverage with 3.58 mm p95. The largest CAD-to-reference residual is an internal contact face beneath the separately selectable rotary base. Other residuals come from the simplified carriage and clamp, and from omitted threads, markings, rubber pads, fasteners, and texture. These figures describe a useful editable reconstruction, not a surface-accurate replica.

## Don't

- Do not replace the exact outer-focus sleeve with a traced mesh or a circular guess.
- Do not use the product photograph for dimensions.
- Do not assess whole-model deviation in the default operating pose; compare the `reference_pose` variant.
